probe_note: https://www.blueapron.com/ returned Cloudflare 'Sorry, you have been blocked' in the T3 preview (default and incognito) and from curl. No login, signup, or identity-provider control was reachable. The public blog at https://blog.blueapron.com/ loaded. No password, email, phone, or code was typed.

nav.note: No signed-in navigation was offered. The shop host that would hold account navigation is the Cloudflare block.

settings.note: No settings control was offered on the public blog, and the shop host did not load.

create.note: No create-account or identity-provider control was mounted on the blog. Affiliates links to an external publisher signup and was not opened.

walls.name: shop-edge-block
walls.asks_for: nothing. Cloudflare block page, heading 'Sorry, you have been blocked'. Not a captcha and not a login form.

gaps: www.blueapron.com menu, membership, subscribe-and-save, gifts, cookbook, about, terms, and privacy did not load past the Cloudflare block.
Sign-in, signup, checkout, and account settings were not reached. No identity provider was shown.
Careers (Workday), Help Center (Zendesk), Affiliates (publisher signup), and social profiles are other hosts and were not opened.
Search was not submitted. The empty cart was photographed and checkout was not started.
